   116→/**
   117→ * Clean up a filename to be more human-readable
   118→ * Removes extension, replaces underscores/hyphens with spaces
   119→ */
   120→function cleanFilename(filename: string): string {
   121→  if (!filename) return '';
   122→  return filename
   123→    .replace(/\.safetensors$/i, '')
   124→    .replace(/\.ckpt$/i, '')
   125→    .replace(/\.pt$/i, '')
   126→    .replace(/_/g, ' ')
   127→    .replace(/-/g, ' ')
   128→    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
   129→    .trim();
   130→}
   131→
   132→/**
   133→ * Get display name from LoRA URL
   134→ * Checks predefined LoRAs first, then availableLoras, then falls back to cleaned filename
   135→ * @param url - The LoRA URL/path
   136→ * @param availableLoras - Optional array of available LoRAs to check against
   137→ * @param fallbackName - Optional name to use if URL doesn't match anything
   138→ */
   139→export function getDisplayNameFromUrl(url: string, availableLoras?: LoraDisplayModel[], fallbackName?: string): string {
   140→  // Check if this is a predefined LoRA
   141→  if (url) {
   142→    const predefinedLora = PREDEFINED_LORAS.find(lora => lora.url === url);
   143→    if (predefinedLora?.displayName) {
   144→      return predefinedLora.displayName;
   145→    }
   146→  }
   147→
   148→  // Check if this is a lora from the search/database
   149→  if (url && availableLoras) {
   150→    const availableLora = availableLoras.find(lora => lora.huggingface_url === url);
   151→    if (availableLora?.Name && availableLora.Name !== "N/A") {
   152→      return availableLora.Name;
   153→    }
   154→  }
   155→
   156→  // Use fallback name if provided and not empty
   157→  if (fallbackName && fallbackName.trim()) {
   158→    return fallbackName;
   159→  }
   160→
   161→  // Otherwise, extract and clean filename from URL
   162→  if (url) {
   163→    const parts = url.split('/');
   164→    const filename = parts[parts.length - 1];
   165→    if (filename) {
   166→      return cleanFilename(filename);
   167→    }
   168→  }
   169→
   170→  return '';
   171→}
   172→

    29→function resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId: string | null): string | null {
    30→  if (projectId && projectId.trim().length > 0) {
    31→    return projectId;
    32→  }
    33→  const selectedProjectId = getProjectSelectionFallbackId();
    34→  if (selectedProjectId && selectedProjectId.trim().length > 0) {
    35→    return selectedProjectId;
    36→  }
    37→  return null;
    38→}

    40→/**
    41→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background.
    42→ */
    43→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    44→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    45→  generationIds: string[],
    46→  projectId: string | null,
    47→  options: PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions = {},
    48→) {
    49→  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
    50→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
    51→  const {
    52→    batchSize = 5,
    53→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    54→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    55→  } = options;
    56→
    57→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    58→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    59→
    60→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId: effectiveProjectId ?? undefined });
    61→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    62→
    63→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    64→
    65→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    66→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    67→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    68→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    69→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    70→        cacheEntry,
    71→      );
    72→
    73→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    74→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    75→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    76→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    77→          showToast: false,
    78→        });
    79→      }
    80→
    81→      if (preloadFullTaskData && effectiveProjectId && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    82→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    83→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId, effectiveProjectId),
    84→          queryFn: async () => {
    85→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    86→              .from('tasks')
    87→              .select('*')
    88→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    89→              .eq('project_id', effectiveProjectId)
    90→              .single();
    91→
    92→            if (error) throw error;
    93→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    94→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    95→            }
    96→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    97→          },
    98→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
    99→        }));
   100→      }
   101→    });
   102→
   103→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
   104→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
   105→    }
   106→
   107→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
   108→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
   109→    }
   110→  }
   111→}
   112→
   113→export function mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(
   114→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   115→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   116→  projectId: string | null,
   117→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   118→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
   119→
   120→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   121→    const generationId = generation.generation_id ?? generation.id;
   122→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   123→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   124→    );
   125→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   126→    const taskData = (taskId && effectiveProjectId)
   127→      ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId, effectiveProjectId))
   128→      : null;
   129→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   130→
   131→    return {
   132→      ...generation,
   133→      taskId,
   134→      taskData,
   135→      taskMappingStatus,
   136→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   137→    };
   138→  });
   139→}

   145→      const { mediaId, shotId } = action.payload;
   146→      const key = `${mediaId}:${shotId}`;
   147→      const newPositioned = new Set(state.optimisticPositionedIds);
   148→      const newUnpositioned = new Set(state.optimisticUnpositionedIds);
   149→      newPositioned.add(key);
   150→      newUnpositioned.delete(key);
   151→      return {
   152→        ...state,
   153→        optimisticPositionedIds: newPositioned,
   154→        optimisticUnpositionedIds: newUnpositioned,
   155→      };
   156→    }
   157→    
   158→    case 'MARK_OPTIMISTIC_DELETED': {
   159→      const newDeleted = new Set(state.optimisticDeletedIds);
   160→      newDeleted.add(action.payload);
   161→      return { ...state, optimisticDeletedIds: newDeleted };
   162→    }
   163→
   164→    case 'MARK_OPTIMISTIC_DELETED_WITH_BACKFILL': {
   165→      // Combined action: mark deleted AND enable backfill loading in ONE state update
   166→      // This ensures skeleton appears in the same render where item disappears
   167→      const newDeleted = new Set(state.optimisticDeletedIds);
   168→      newDeleted.add(action.payload);
   169→      return { ...state, optimisticDeletedIds: newDeleted, isBackfillLoading: true };
   170→    }
   171→
   172→    case 'REMOVE_OPTIMISTIC_DELETED': {
   173→      const newDeleted = new Set(state.optimisticDeletedIds);
   174→      newDeleted.delete(action.payload);
   175→      return { ...state, optimisticDeletedIds: newDeleted };
   176→    }
   177→    
   178→    case 'RECONCILE_OPTIMISTIC_STATE': {
   179→      const currentImageIds = action.payload;
   180→
   181→      // Clean up optimistic sets - remove entries for images no longer in the list
   182→      // Composite keys are in format mediaId:shotId
   183→      const newUnpositioned = new Set<string>();
   184→      for (const key of state.optimisticUnpositionedIds) {
   185→        const mediaId = key.split(':')[0];
   186→        if (currentImageIds.has(mediaId)) {
   187→          newUnpositioned.add(key);
   188→        }
   189→      }
   190→
   191→      const newPositioned = new Set<string>();
   192→      for (const key of state.optimisticPositionedIds) {
   193→        const mediaId = key.split(':')[0];
   194→        if (currentImageIds.has(mediaId)) {
   195→          newPositioned.add(key);
   196→        }
   197→      }
   198→
   199→      const newDeleted = new Set<string>();
   200→      for (const id of state.optimisticDeletedIds) {
   201→        if (currentImageIds.has(id)) {
   202→          newDeleted.add(id);
   203→        }
   204→      }
   205→      
   206→      return {
   207→        ...state,
   208→        optimisticUnpositionedIds: newUnpositioned,
   209→        optimisticPositionedIds: newPositioned,
   210→        optimisticDeletedIds: newDeleted,
   211→      };
   212→    }
   213→    
   214→    case 'SET_SELECTED_SHOT_ID_LOCAL':
   215→      return { ...state, selectedShotIdLocal: action.payload };
   216→      
   217→    case 'SET_SHOW_TICK_FOR_IMAGE_ID':
   218→      return { ...state, showTickForImageId: action.payload };
   219→      
   220→    case 'SET_SHOW_TICK_FOR_SECONDARY_IMAGE_ID':
   221→      return { ...state, showTickForSecondaryImageId: action.payload };
   222→      
   223→    case 'SET_ADDING_TO_SHOT_IMAGE_ID':
   224→      return { ...state, addingToShotImageId: action.payload };
   225→      
   226→    case 'SET_ADDING_TO_SHOT_WITHOUT_POSITION_IMAGE_ID':
   227→      return { ...state, addingToShotWithoutPositionImageId: action.payload };
   228→      
   229→    case 'SET_DOWNLOADING_IMAGE_ID':
   230→      return { ...state, downloadingImageId: action.payload };
   231→      
   232→    case 'SET_DOWNLOADING_STARRED':
   233→      return { ...state, isDownloadingStarred: action.payload };
   234→      
   235→    case 'SET_MOBILE_ACTIVE_IMAGE_ID':
   236→      return { ...state, mobileActiveImageId: action.payload };
   237→      
   238→    case 'SET_MOBILE_POPOVER_OPEN_IMAGE_ID':
   239→      return { ...state, mobilePopoverOpenImageId: action.payload };
   240→      
   241→    case 'SET_BACKFILL_LOADING':
   242→      return { ...state, isBackfillLoading: action.payload };
   243→      
   244→    case 'SET_BACKFILL_SKELETON_COUNT':
   245→      return { ...state, backfillSkeletonCount: action.payload };
   246→
   247→    case 'RESET_UI_STATE':
   248→      return {
   249→        ...state,
   250→        showTickForImageId: null,
   251→        showTickForSecondaryImageId: null,
   252→        addingToShotImageId: null,
   253→        addingToShotWithoutPositionImageId: null,
   254→        downloadingImageId: null,
   255→        isDownloadingStarred: false,
   256→        mobileActiveImageId: null,
   257→        mobilePopoverOpenImageId: null,
   258→      };
   259→      
   260→    default:
   261→      return state;
   262→  }
   263→};
   264→
   265→interface UseMediaGalleryStateOptimizedProps {
   266→  images: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[];
   267→  currentShotId?: string;
   268→  lastShotId?: string;
   269→  simplifiedShotOptions: { id: string; name: string }[];
   270→  isServerPagination?: boolean;
   271→  serverPage?: number;
   272→}
   273→
   274→interface UseMediaGalleryStateOptimizedReturn {
   275→  // State
   276→  state: MediaGalleryState;
   277→  
   278→  // Actions
   279→  setActiveLightboxMedia: (media: GeneratedImageWithMetadata | null) => void;
   280→  setAutoEnterEditMode: (value: boolean) => void;
   281→  setSelectedImageForDetails: (image: GeneratedImageWithMetadata | null) => void;
   282→  setShowTaskDetailsModal: (show: boolean) => void;
   283→  setPendingLightboxTarget: (target: 'first' | 'last' | null) => void;
   284→  markOptimisticUnpositioned: (imageId: string, shotId: string) => void;
   285→  markOptimisticPositioned: (imageId: string, shotId: string) => void;
   286→  markOptimisticDeleted: (imageId: string) => void;
   287→  markOptimisticDeletedWithBackfill: (imageId: string) => void;
   288→  removeOptimisticDeleted: (imageId: string) => void;
   289→  setSelectedShotIdLocal: (id: string) => void;
   290→  setShowTickForImageId: (id: string | null) => void;
   291→  setShowTickForSecondaryImageId: (id: string | null) => void;
   292→  setAddingToShotImageId: (id: string | null) => void;
   293→  setAddingToShotWithoutPositionImageId: (id: string | null) => void;
   294→  setDownloadingImageId: (id: string | null) => void;
   295→  setIsDownloadingStarred: (downloading: boolean) => void;
   296→  setMobileActiveImageId: (id: string | null) => void;
   297→  setMobilePopoverOpenImageId: (id: string | null) => void;
   298→  setIsBackfillLoading: (loading: boolean) => void;
   299→  setBackfillSkeletonCount: (count: number) => void;
   300→  resetUIState: () => void;
   301→  
   302→  // Refs (unchanged)
   303→  mainTickTimeoutRef: React.MutableRefObject<NodeJS.Timeout | null>;
   304→  secondaryTickTimeoutRef: React.MutableRefObject<NodeJS.Timeout | null>;
   305→  galleryTopRef: React.MutableRefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
   306→  safetyTimeoutRef: React.MutableRefObject<NodeJS.Timeout | null>;
   307→}
   308→
   309→function clearTimer(timeoutRef: React.MutableRefObject<NodeJS.Timeout | null>): void {
   310→  const timeoutId = timeoutRef.current;
   311→  if (!timeoutId) {
   312→    return;
   313→  }
   314→
   315→  clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   316→  timeoutRef.current = null;
   317→}
   318→
   319→export const useMediaGalleryStateOptimized = ({
   320→  images,
   321→  currentShotId,
   322→  lastShotId,
   323→  simplifiedShotOptions,
   324→}: UseMediaGalleryStateOptimizedProps): UseMediaGalleryStateOptimizedReturn => {
   325→  
   326→  // Initialize state with useReducer instead of multiple useState calls
   327→  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(
   328→    mediaGalleryStateReducer,
   329→    createInitialState(currentShotId, lastShotId, simplifiedShotOptions)
   330→  );
   331→  
   332→  // Memoized action creators to prevent unnecessary re-renders
   333→  const actions = useMemo(() => ({
   334→    setActiveLightboxMedia: (media: GeneratedImageWithMetadata | null) => {
   335→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_LIGHTBOX_MEDIA', payload: media });
   336→    },
   337→    setAutoEnterEditMode: (value: boolean) =>
   338→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_AUTO_ENTER_EDIT_MODE', payload: value }),
   339→    setSelectedImageForDetails: (image: GeneratedImageWithMetadata | null) =>
   340→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_SELECTED_IMAGE_FOR_DETAILS', payload: image }),
   341→    setShowTaskDetailsModal: (show: boolean) =>
   342→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_SHOW_TASK_DETAILS_MODAL', payload: show }),
   343→    setPendingLightboxTarget: (target: 'first' | 'last' | null) => {
   344→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_PENDING_LIGHTBOX_TARGET', payload: target });
   345→    },
   346→    markOptimisticUnpositioned: (imageId: string, shotId: string) => 
   347→      dispatch({ type: 'MARK_OPTIMISTIC_UNPOSITIONED', payload: { mediaId: imageId, shotId } }),
   348→    markOptimisticPositioned: (imageId: string, shotId: string) => 
   349→      dispatch({ type: 'MARK_OPTIMISTIC_POSITIONED', payload: { mediaId: imageId, shotId } }),
   350→    markOptimisticDeleted: (imageId: string) =>
   351→      dispatch({ type: 'MARK_OPTIMISTIC_DELETED', payload: imageId }),
   352→    markOptimisticDeletedWithBackfill: (imageId: string) =>
   353→      dispatch({ type: 'MARK_OPTIMISTIC_DELETED_WITH_BACKFILL', payload: imageId }),
   354→    removeOptimisticDeleted: (imageId: string) => 
   355→      dispatch({ type: 'REMOVE_OPTIMISTIC_DELETED', payload: imageId }),
   356→    setSelectedShotIdLocal: (id: string) => 
   357→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_SELECTED_SHOT_ID_LOCAL', payload: id }),
   358→    setShowTickForImageId: (id: string | null) => 
   359→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_SHOW_TICK_FOR_IMAGE_ID', payload: id }),
   360→    setShowTickForSecondaryImageId: (id: string | null) => 
   361→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_SHOW_TICK_FOR_SECONDARY_IMAGE_ID', payload: id }),
   362→    setAddingToShotImageId: (id: string | null) => 
   363→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_ADDING_TO_SHOT_IMAGE_ID', payload: id }),
   364→    setAddingToShotWithoutPositionImageId: (id: string | null) => 
   365→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_ADDING_TO_SHOT_WITHOUT_POSITION_IMAGE_ID', payload: id }),
   366→    setDownloadingImageId: (id: string | null) => 
   367→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_DOWNLOADING_IMAGE_ID', payload: id }),
   368→    setIsDownloadingStarred: (downloading: boolean) => 
   369→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_DOWNLOADING_STARRED', payload: downloading }),
   370→    setMobileActiveImageId: (id: string | null) => 
   371→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_MOBILE_ACTIVE_IMAGE_ID', payload: id }),
   372→    setMobilePopoverOpenImageId: (id: string | null) => 
   373→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_MOBILE_POPOVER_OPEN_IMAGE_ID', payload: id }),
   374→    setIsBackfillLoading: (loading: boolean) => 
   375→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_BACKFILL_LOADING', payload: loading }),
   376→    setBackfillSkeletonCount: (count: number) =>
   377→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_BACKFILL_SKELETON_COUNT', payload: count }),
   378→    resetUIState: () =>
   379→      dispatch({ type: 'RESET_UI_STATE' }),
   380→  }), []);
   381→  
   382→  // Refs (unchanged from original)
   383→  const mainTickTimeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
   384→  const secondaryTickTimeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
   385→  const galleryTopRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
   386→  const safetyTimeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
   387→
   388→  // Track previous lastShotId to detect when user navigates to a different shot
   389→  const prevLastShotIdRef = useRef<string | undefined>(lastShotId);
   390→  
   391→  // Sync selectedShotIdLocal when:
   392→  // 1. lastShotId changes (user navigated to a different shot)
   393→  // 2. Current selection is invalid (empty or shot no longer exists)
   394→  useEffect(() => {
   395→    const isCurrentSelectionValid = state.selectedShotIdLocal && simplifiedShotOptions.find(shot => shot.id === state.selectedShotIdLocal);
   396→    const lastShotIdChanged = lastShotId && lastShotId !== prevLastShotIdRef.current;
   397→    
   398→    // Update ref for next comparison
   399→    prevLastShotIdRef.current = lastShotId;
   400→    
   401→    // Sync when lastShotId changes (user clicked into a shot)
   402→    if (lastShotIdChanged && lastShotId !== state.selectedShotIdLocal) {
   403→      actions.setSelectedShotIdLocal(lastShotId);
   404→      return;
   405→    }
   406→    
   407→    // Fix invalid selections (empty or shot no longer exists)
   408→    if (!isCurrentSelectionValid) {
   409→      const newSelection = lastShotId || (simplifiedShotOptions.length > 0 ? simplifiedShotOptions[0].id : "");
   410→      if (newSelection && newSelection !== state.selectedShotIdLocal) {
   411→        actions.setSelectedShotIdLocal(newSelection);
   412→      }
   413→    }
   414→  }, [lastShotId, simplifiedShotOptions, state.selectedShotIdLocal, actions]);
   415→
   416→  // Memoize image IDs to prevent unnecessary effect triggers
   417→  const currentImageIds = useMemo(() => 
   418→    new Set(images.map(img => img.id)), 
   419→    [images]
   420→  );
   421→
   422→  // Reconcile optimistic state when images update
   423→  useEffect(() => {
   424→    // Sync activeLightboxMedia with updated images list to ensure fresh data (like name changes)
   425→    if (state.activeLightboxMedia) {
   426→      const activeLightbox = state.activeLightboxMedia;
   427→      const updatedImage = images.find(img => img.id === activeLightbox.id);
   428→      // Only update if the object reference changed (meaning data changed or refetched)
   429→      // and deep equality check on key properties to avoid unnecessary render cycles
   430→      if (updatedImage && updatedImage !== state.activeLightboxMedia) {
   431→        // Check if relevant fields actually changed to prevent loop.
   432→        const nameChanged = updatedImage.name !== state.activeLightboxMedia.name;
   433→        const starredChanged = updatedImage.starred !== state.activeLightboxMedia.starred;
   434→        const urlChanged = updatedImage.url !== state.activeLightboxMedia.url;
   435→
   436→        if (nameChanged || starredChanged || urlChanged) {
   437→          const autoEnterFlag = state.activeLightboxMedia.metadata?.__autoEnterEditMode as boolean | undefined;
   438→          actions.setActiveLightboxMedia({
   439→            ...updatedImage,
   440→            metadata: autoEnterFlag === undefined
   441→              ? updatedImage.metadata
   442→              : { ...updatedImage.metadata, __autoEnterEditMode: autoEnterFlag },
   443→          });
   444→        }
   445→      }
   446→    }
   447→
   448→    // Clean up optimistic sets using the consolidated action
   449→    dispatch({ type: 'RECONCILE_OPTIMISTIC_STATE', payload: currentImageIds });
   450→  }, [currentImageIds, images, actions, state.activeLightboxMedia]);
   451→
   452→  // Cleanup timeouts on unmount
   453→  useEffect(() => {
   454→    return () => {
   455→      clearTimer(mainTickTimeoutRef);
   456→      clearTimer(secondaryTickTimeoutRef);
   457→      clearTimer(safetyTimeoutRef);
   458→    };
   459→  }, []);
   460→
   461→  return {
   462→    state,
   463→    ...actions,
   464→    
   465→    // Refs
   466→    mainTickTimeoutRef,
   467→    secondaryTickTimeoutRef,
   468→    galleryTopRef,
   469→    safetyTimeoutRef,
   470→  };
   471→};
   472→

    20→
    21→function asNullableString(value: unknown): string | null {
    22→  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : null;
    23→}
    24→
    25→/**
    26→ * Sanitize task data before caching in shared_generations
    27→ * Removes potentially sensitive fields from params
    28→ */
    29→function sanitizeTaskDataForSharing(taskData: Record<string, unknown> | null): Record<string, unknown> | null {
    30→  if (!taskData) return null;
    31→  
    32→  const sanitized = { ...taskData };
    33→
    34→  const redactDeep = (value: unknown, depth: number = 0): unknown => {
    35→    if (depth > 6) return null;
    36→    if (value == null) return value;
    37→    if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((v) => redactDeep(v, depth + 1));
    38→    if (typeof value !== 'object') return value;
    39→
    40→    const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    41→    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(value)) {
    42→      // Strip any obviously sensitive keys
    43→      if (/(api[_-]?key|token|secret|password|service_role|authorization|stripe)/i.test(k)) {
    44→        continue;
    45→      }
    46→      out[k] = redactDeep(v, depth + 1);
    47→    }
    48→    return out;
    49→  };
    50→  
    51→  // Remove or sanitize sensitive fields from params
    52→  if (sanitized.params) {
    53→    sanitized.params = redactDeep(sanitized.params);
    54→  }
    55→  
    56→  // Remove fields that shouldn't be exposed
    57→  delete sanitized.error_message; // Could contain internal details
    58→  
    59→  return sanitized;
    60→}

    62→/**

    84→  // Generate a short, URL-friendly random string

    91→    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {

    95→    return result;

   109→    }
   110→
   111→    // If share already exists (in local state), copy to clipboard
   112→    if (shareSlug) {
   113→      const shareUrl = `${window.location.origin}/share/${shareSlug}`;
   114→
   115→      // Use fallback for iOS compatibility
   116→      try {
   117→        // Try modern API first
   118→        if (navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
   119→          await navigator.clipboard.writeText(shareUrl);
   120→        }
   121→      } catch {
   122→        // Fallback: use textarea + execCommand (works on iOS)
   123→        const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
   124→        textarea.value = shareUrl;
   125→        textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
   126→        textarea.style.opacity = '0';
   127→        document.body.appendChild(textarea);
   128→        textarea.focus();
   129→        textarea.select();
   130→        document.execCommand('copy');
   131→        document.body.removeChild(textarea);
   132→      }
   133→
   134→      setShareCopied(true);
   135→      toast({
   136→        title: "Link copied!",
   137→        description: "Share link copied to clipboard"
   138→      });
   139→      setTimeout(() => setShareCopied(false), 2000);
   140→      return;
   141→    }
   142→
   143→    // Create new share (client-side) or fetch existing
   144→    setIsCreatingShare(true);
   145→
   146→    try {

   149→      if (!session?.session?.access_token) {

   157→      }
   158→
   159→      // First, check if share already exists in DB
   160→      const { data: existingShare, error: existingError } = await supabase().from('shared_generations')
   161→        .select('share_slug')
   162→        .eq('generation_id', generationId)
   163→        .eq('creator_id', session.session.user.id)
   164→        .maybeSingle();
   165→
   166→      if (existingError && !isNotFoundError(existingError)) {

   168→        toast({

   176→
   177→      if (existingShare) {

   207→      if (generationResult.error) {

   209→        toast({

   217→

   260→            const generationMode = travelSettings.generationMode || 'batch';

   263→            const images = shotGenerations

   213→      ? `Saved LoRAs (${currentSavedLoras.length}):\\n${currentSavedLoras.map((lora) => `• ${lora.id} (strength: ${lora.strength})`).join('\\n')}`

1→export type OperationFailurePolicy = 'fail_closed' | 'fail_open' | 'degrade' | 'best_effort';
     2→
     3→interface OperationSuccess<T> {
     4→  ok: true;
     5→  value: T;
     6→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
     7→  recoverable: false;
     8→}
     9→
    10→export interface OperationFailure {
    11→  ok: false;
    12→  error: Error;
    13→  message: string;
    14→  recoverable: boolean;
    15→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    16→  errorCode: string;
    17→  cause?: unknown;
    18→}
    19→
    20→export type OperationResult<T> = OperationSuccess<T> | OperationFailure;
    21→
    22→export class OperationResultError extends Error {
    23→  errorCode: string;
    24→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    25→  recoverable: boolean;
    26→  cause?: unknown;
    27→
    28→  constructor(options: {
    29→    message: string;
    30→    errorCode: string;
    31→    policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    32→    recoverable: boolean;
    33→    cause?: unknown;
    34→    sourceError?: Error;
    35→  }) {
    36→    super(options.message);
    37→    this.name = 'OperationResultError';
    38→    this.errorCode = options.errorCode;
    39→    this.policy = options.policy;
    40→    this.recoverable = options.recoverable;
    41→    this.cause = options.cause;
    42→
    43→    // Preserve the original stack for easier debugging when available.
    44→    if (options.sourceError?.stack) {
    45→      this.stack = options.sourceError.stack;
    46→    }
    47→  }
    48→}
    49→
    50→interface OperationSuccessOptions {
    51→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    52→}
    53→
    54→interface OperationFailureOptions {
    55→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    56→  recoverable?: boolean;
    57→  errorCode?: string;
    58→  message?: string;
    59→  cause?: unknown;
    60→}
    61→
    62→export function operationSuccess<T>(value: T, options?: OperationSuccessOptions): OperationSuccess<T> {
    63→  return {
    64→    ok: true,
    65→    value,
    66→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    67→    recoverable: false,
    68→  };
    69→}
    70→
    71→export function operationFailure(error: unknown, options?: OperationFailureOptions): OperationFailure {
    72→  const normalizedError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    73→  return {
    74→    ok: false,
    75→    error: normalizedError,
    76→    message: options?.message ?? normalizedError.message,
    77→    recoverable: options?.recoverable ?? true,
    78→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    79→    errorCode: options?.errorCode ?? 'operation_failed',
    80→    ...(options?.cause !== undefined ? { cause: options.cause } : {}),
    81→  };
    82→}
    83→
    84→/**
    85→ * Convert a structured operation failure into an Error while preserving machine-readable metadata.
    86→ */
    87→export function toOperationResultError(failure: OperationFailure): OperationResultError {
    88→  return new OperationResultError({
    89→    message: failure.message,
    90→    errorCode: failure.errorCode,
    91→    policy: failure.policy,
    92→    recoverable: failure.recoverable,
    93→    cause: failure.cause,
    94→    sourceError: failure.error,
    95→  });
    96→}

    52→      setPromoteSuccess(true);
    53→      setTimeout(() => setPromoteSuccess(false), 2000);
    54→    } catch (error) {
    55→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useVariantPromotion', showToast: false });
    56→    }
    57→  }, [promoteVariantMutation, selectedProjectId]);
    58→
    59→  // Handler for "Add as new image to shot" button in ShotSelectorControls
    60→  // Positions new image between current and next item in the TARGET shot
    61→  const handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot = useCallback(async (
    62→    shotId: string,
    63→    variantId: string,
    64→    currentTimelineFrame?: number
    65→  ): Promise<boolean> => {
    66→    if (!selectedProjectId) {
    67→      toast.error('No project selected');
    68→      return false;
    69→    }
    70→
    71→    try {
    72→      // 1. Create the generation from the variant
    73→      const newGen = await promoteVariantMutation.mutateAsync({
    74→        variantId,
    75→        projectId: selectedProjectId,
    76→      });
    77→
    78→      // 2. Calculate target timeline frame by querying the TARGET shot's items
    79→      let targetTimelineFrame: number | undefined;
    80→      if (currentTimelineFrame !== undefined) {
    81→        // Query all items in the target shot to find next item and calculate average spacing
    82→        const { data: allShotItems } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    83→          .select('timeline_frame')
    84→          .eq('shot_id', shotId)
    85→          .not('timeline_frame', 'is', null)
    86→          .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true });
    87→
    88→        const frames = (allShotItems || [])
    89→          .map(item => item.timeline_frame as number)
    90→          .filter(f => f !== null && f !== undefined);
    91→
    92→        // Find the next item after current position
    93→        const nextTimelineFrame = frames.find(f => f > currentTimelineFrame);
    94→
    95→        if (nextTimelineFrame !== undefined && nextTimelineFrame > currentTimelineFrame) {
    96→          // Place in the middle between current and next
    97→          targetTimelineFrame = Math.floor((currentTimelineFrame + nextTimelineFrame) / 2);
    98→          // If middle would be same as current (consecutive frames), use current + 1
    99→          if (targetTimelineFrame === currentTimelineFrame) {
   100→            targetTimelineFrame = currentTimelineFrame + 1;
   101→          }
   102→        } else {
   103→          // No next item in shot - calculate average spacing and use that
   104→          if (frames.length >= 2) {
   105→            // Calculate average gap between consecutive frames
   106→            let totalGap = 0;
   107→            for (let i = 1; i < frames.length; i++) {
   108→              totalGap += frames[i] - frames[i - 1];
   109→            }
   110→            const averageGap = Math.round(totalGap / (frames.length - 1));
   111→            targetTimelineFrame = currentTimelineFrame + Math.max(1, averageGap);
   112→          } else {
   113→            // Only one item in shot, use current + 1
   114→            targetTimelineFrame = currentTimelineFrame + 1;
   115→          }
   116→        }
   117→      }
   118→
   119→      // 3. Add to shot
   120→      await addImageToShotMutation.mutateAsync({
   121→        shot_id: shotId,
   122→        generation_id: newGen.id,
   123→        project_id: selectedProjectId,
   124→        imageUrl: newGen.location,
   125→        thumbUrl: newGen.thumbnail_url || undefined,
   126→        timelineFrame: targetTimelineFrame,
   127→      });
   128→      return true;
   129→    } catch (error) {
   130→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useVariantPromotion', showToast: false });
   131→      return false;
   132→    }
   133→  }, [promoteVariantMutation, addImageToShotMutation, selectedProjectId]);
   134→
   135→  return {
   136→    promoteSuccess,
   137→    isPromoting: promoteVariantMutation.isPending,
   138→    handlePromoteToGeneration,
   139→    handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot,
   140→  };
   141→}
   142→

   398→export function useInlineEditState(

   401→): InlineEditStateResult {
   402→  const env = useInlineEditEnvironment(media);
   403→  const persistence = useInlineEditPersistence(env.actualGenerationId, env.selectedProjectId);
   404→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   405→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;
   406→  useEffect(() => {
   407→    env.setUpscaleActiveVariant(activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id);
   408→  }, [env, activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id]);
   409→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   410→  const { inpainting, magic } = useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(media, env, persistence);
   411→  const reposition = useInlineEditReposition(media, env, inpainting, persistence);
   412→  const img2img = useInlineEditImg2Img(media, env, persistence, availableLoras);
   413→  useInlineEditSettingsSync(env.actualGenerationId, persistence.editSettings, inpainting);
   414→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   415→    media,

   417→      ? async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id)
   418→      : undefined,

   420→  const starToggle = useStarToggle({ media });

    37→    timeoutIdsRef.current.clear();
    38→  }, []);

## Analysis: Why ENRICH Stage Produced Inaccurate Step Details

### 1. WHERE the accuracy failure happened

The failure is both a **process gap** and a **tooling gap**, but the root cause is a process gap that the tooling should have prevented.

**The causal chain:**

1. **SCAN** produced 92 review issues, each with a `summary` field (e.g., "useInlineEditState is a 468-line orchestrator that manually reshapes ~10 hook returns with zero behavioral contribution"). These summaries are LLM-generated during the review scan and are themselves compressed characterizations -- they may be imprecise, hyperbolic, or wrong about specifics.

2. **ORGANIZE** created clusters and steps from these summaries. Steps at this point are titles like "Inline useInlineEditState hook" -- reasonable, but thin.

3. **ENRICH** deployed 4 subagents to add `--detail` to each step. Here is the critical failure: **the subagents' only input was the plan data (step titles + issue summaries). They never read source files.** They wrote "executor-ready" detail by paraphrasing and elaborating on summaries that were already imprecise.

4. **The `_shallow_steps` blocker** (lines 232-247 of `_stage_validation.py`) only checks `not s.get("detail") and not s.get("issue_refs")` -- it checks for **presence** of a detail string, not whether the detail is **accurate** or **source-verified**.

5. **The `_confirm_enrich` handler** (lines 353-424 of `confirmations.py`) re-runs `_shallow_steps` at confirmation time, then validates the attestation text references a cluster name. Again: purely structural checks.

The failure point is between steps 2 and 3: the ENRICH stage has no mechanism to require or verify that agents actually consulted source code. The summaries from SCAN are treated as ground truth, but they are approximations.

### 2. WHAT the tooling could enforce

The current `_shallow_steps` function checks exactly one thing: does the step dict have a truthy `detail` or `issue_refs` key? This is a **presence check**, equivalent to checking that a field is non-empty. It is the weakest possible validation.

What it could check additionally:

**A. Source file references in detail text.** Step detail that claims to modify `useInlineEditState` should reference a specific file path. The tooling could require that `detail` contains at least one file path that actually exists in the project. The issue data already contains a `file` field and `related_files` list -- this is available.

**B. Detail minimum quality heuristics.** A detail string that is just a rephrased version of the step title provides no new information. The tooling could check that `detail` adds substantive content beyond the `title` (e.g., minimum character length, or that it contains information not present in the title).

**C. A `source_verified` flag.** Steps could carry metadata indicating whether the detail was written after reading source code vs. synthesized from issue summaries alone. The tooling could require this flag at the ENRICH stage.

### 3. Should ENRICH require agents to READ actual source files?

**Yes, absolutely.** This is the core design flaw. The purpose of ENRICH is to make steps "executor-ready for an agent with zero context." An agent with zero context needs file paths, function names, line counts, and behavioral descriptions that are actually correct. Detail synthesized from issue summaries is just repackaged scan output -- it adds no new information and propagates scan errors.

**How to enforce it:**

**Option A: Structural enforcement via step schema.** Add required fields to the step dict that can only be populated by reading source code:

- `verified_files: list[str]` -- files the enricher actually read. The tooling validates these paths exist.
- `verified_at: str` -- timestamp of verification.
- `source_facts: list[str]` -- specific facts extracted from source (function count, line count, actual behavior) that the enricher attests to.

Then `_shallow_steps` expands to check: does the step have `detail` AND `verified_files` with at least one valid path?

**Option B: Process enforcement via enricher instructions.** The ENRICH stage's prompt/instructions to subagents must require them to: (1) read each file referenced by the cluster's issues, (2) include specific source-verified facts in the detail, (3) correct any inaccuracies in the original issue summaries.

**Option C: Post-enrichment spot-check validation.** After ENRICH completes, run a validation pass that samples N steps, reads the referenced files, and checks whether the claims in `detail` match reality. This is the most robust but most expensive option.

The practical answer is **A + B together**: structural enforcement makes it impossible to skip reading code, and process enforcement ensures agents know what to extract.

### 4. Is this a ceremony problem or a usage problem?

**Both**, but primarily a ceremony problem.

It is true that the subagents were deployed without instructions to read source code -- that is a usage error. But the ceremony's job is to prevent exactly this kind of error. The 5-stage flow exists precisely because agents take shortcuts when unconstrained. The ENRICH stage's blocker (`_shallow_steps`) is supposed to be the guardrail that prevents low-quality enrichment from passing through. It fails at this because it only checks for presence, not accuracy.

The ceremony told agents to "make steps executor-ready" but gave them no structural requirement that forced them to consult source code. The human message in `_cmd_stage_enrich` (line 487-493) says "double-check that every step is clear enough for an executor with zero context" but there is no tooling that verifies this was done.

This is analogous to the OBSERVE stage's original problem: before the citation gate was removed, it required agents to cite issue IDs -- a structural check that forced engagement with the data. The ENRICH stage lacks any equivalent structural forcing function.

### 5. Concrete proposed changes

**Change 1: Add `verified_files` to step schema and validate in `_shallow_steps`**

In `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/plan/triage/_stage_validation.py`, modify `_shallow_steps` (lines 232-247):

Current logic:
```python
bare = sum(
    1 for s in steps
    if isinstance(s, dict) and not s.get("detail") and not s.get("issue_refs")
)
```

Proposed logic: add a second check for *unverified* steps -- steps that have `detail` but no `verified_files`:

```python
# Steps without any detail at all
bare = sum(1 for s in steps if isinstance(s, dict) and not s.get("detail") and not s.get("issue_refs"))
# Steps with detail but no source verification
unverified = sum(1 for s in steps if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("detail") and not s.get("verified_files"))
```

Return both counts. The ENRICH blocker should block on unverified steps, not just bare steps.

**Change 2: Validate `verified_files` paths exist**

Add a new validation function in `_stage_validation.py` that checks whether `verified_files` entries are real paths relative to the project root. This can use the existing state's file index or a filesystem check. This prevents agents from stuffing fake paths.

**Change 3: Add `--verified-files` to the `cluster update` step commands**

In `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/plan/cluster_handlers.py`, the `_cmd_cluster_update` function (line 608) handles `--update-step` with `--detail`. Add a `--verified-files` parameter that records which files the agent read when writing the detail. The parser group in `parser_groups_plan_impl.py` needs the new argument.

**Change 4: Tighten `_confirm_enrich` to require verification**

In `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/plan/triage/confirmations.py`, the `_confirm_enrich` handler (line 353) already re-runs `_shallow_steps`. It should also check for unverified steps and block confirmation if any exist.

**Change 5: Add a detail-vs-source spot-check at confirm time**

At `_confirm_enrich` time, sample 2-3 steps randomly, read the `verified_files` for each, and run a lightweight check: do the claims in `detail` (file paths, function names, counts) appear in the actual source? This is the strongest enforcement -- it catches agents that populate `verified_files` but still synthesize detail from summaries. This could be a separate validation function called from `_confirm_enrich`.

**Change 6: Update the ENRICH stage's guidance message**

The `print_user_message` in `_cmd_stage_enrich` (line 487-493) and the `_enrich_report_or_error` guidance (lines 250-262) should explicitly state: "Every step must include verified_files -- the actual source files you read to write the detail. Steps without source verification will be blocked."

### Implementation sequencing

1. **Step schema change** (verified_files field) -- this is the foundation
2. **CLI parameter** (--verified-files on cluster update) -- enables agents to record verification
3. **Validation tightening** (_shallow_steps + _confirm_enrich) -- enforces the new requirement
4. **Path existence validation** -- prevents fake paths
5. **Spot-check at confirm time** -- catches sophisticated circumvention (optional, high-value)

### Critical Files for Implementation
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/plan/triage/_stage_validation.py` - Core validation: `_shallow_steps` must be expanded to check `verified_files`, and a new path-existence validator added
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/plan/triage/confirmations.py` - `_confirm_enrich` must block on unverified steps and optionally run spot-checks
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/plan/cluster_handlers.py` - `_cmd_cluster_update` needs `--verified-files` parameter support for step enrichment
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/plan/triage/stage_flow_commands.py` - `_cmd_stage_enrich` guidance messages must describe the new verification requirement
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/cli_support/parser_groups_plan_impl.py` - Parser definition needs the new `--verified-files` argument on cluster update subcommand

   301→    >
   302→      <div
   303→        data-lightbox-bg
   304→        className={cn('flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden', isDesktopPanel ? 'flex-1 touch-none' : 'flex-none touch-none z-10')}

   306→          ? { width: '60%' }

   310→                ? `translateX(${model.contexts.navigation.swipeNavigation.swipeOffset}px)`

   316→      >

   338→            positionStrategy="fixed"

   340→            freeFormInactiveClassName="bg-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-600 text-white"
   341→            deleteButtonClassName="bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white"
   342→          />

   344→        <OverlayElements model={model} topCenterClassName={model.layout.topCenterClassName} showFloatingTools={true} />
   345→
   346→        {!isDesktopPanel && (

   353→            hasNext={model.contexts.navigation.hasNext}

   361→        className={cn('bg-background overflow-hidden relative z-[60] overscroll-none', isDesktopPanel ? 'border-l border-border h-full' : 'border-t border-border overflow-y-auto')}
   362→        style={isDesktopPanel ? { width: '40%' } : { height: '50%' }}
   363→      >

   377→      onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}

   415→          showFloatingTools={false}

   419→        <NavigationArrows

   424→          hasPrevious={model.contexts.navigation.hasPrevious}
   425→          hasNext={model.contexts.navigation.hasNext}

   430→    </div>

   - `handleAutoTopupThresholdChange` at line 93 - sets local state, debounced `updateAutoTopup` at line 101. CORRECT.

1→/**
     2→ * Shared Generation Data Transformers
     3→ * 
     4→ * SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for transforming generation data from database to UI format.
     5→ * 
     6→ * This eliminates the need to manually update transformation logic in multiple places
     7→ * when adding new fields. Instead, update once here and all consumers automatically
     8→ * get the new field.
     9→ * 
    10→ * Architecture Benefits:
    11→ * - DRY: No duplicated transformation logic across hooks/components
    12→ * - Type Safety: Centralized TypeScript types ensure consistency
    13→ * - Maintainability: Add new fields in one place instead of 5+
    14→ * - Testability: Can unit test transformations in isolation
    15→ * 
    16→ * NOTE: upscaled_url has been removed - upscaled versions are now stored as
    17→ * generation_variants with variant_type='upscaled' and become the primary variant,
    18→ * so `location` already contains the best available URL.
    19→ */
    20→
    21→import type { GeneratedImageWithMetadata } from '@/shared/components/MediaGallery/types';
    22→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    23→import type { GenerationMetadata } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    24→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    25→import { stripQueryParameters } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaUrl';
    26→import { TOOL_IDS, isToolId } from '@/shared/lib/toolIds';
    27→import { ServerError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
    28→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    29→import { expandShotData } from '@/shared/lib/shotData';
    30→import { parseGenerationTaskId } from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskIdParser';
    31→import { filterUuidStrings } from '@/shared/lib/uuid';
    32→
    33→/**
    34→ * Result type for calculateDerivedCounts
    35→ */
    36→export interface DerivedCountsResult {
    37→  /** Count of variants/derivatives per generation */
    38→  derivedCounts: Record<string, number>;
    39→  /** Whether each generation has any unviewed variants (viewed_at IS NULL) */
    40→  hasUnviewedVariants: Record<string, boolean>;
    41→  /** Count of unviewed variants per generation */
    42→  unviewedVariantCounts: Record<string, number>;
    43→  /** True when counts were intentionally returned empty due to a read-path failure. */
    44→  degraded?: boolean;
    45→  /** Machine-readable reason for degraded fallback behavior. */
    46→  errorCode?: 'query_failed';
    47→}
    48→
    49→function createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(): DerivedCountsResult {
    50→  return {
    51→    derivedCounts: {},
    52→    hasUnviewedVariants: {},
    53→    unviewedVariantCounts: {},
    54→  };
    55→}
    56→
    57→/**
    58→ * Calculate derivedCount for generations (how many variants/derivatives exist)
    59→ * Also tracks whether any variants are unviewed (for NEW badge display)
    60→ *
    61→ * Queries both:
    62→ * - generations table (based_on relationships)
    63→ * - generation_variants table (edit variants)
    64→ *
    65→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to count variants for
    66→ * @returns Object with derivedCounts and hasUnviewedVariants maps
    67→ */
    68→async function calculateDerivedCounts(
    69→  generationIds: string[]
    70→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
    71→  const persistedGenerationIds = filterUuidStrings(generationIds);
    72→  if (persistedGenerationIds.length === 0) {
    73→    return createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    77→
    78→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    79→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    80→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    81→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    82→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    83→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    84→
    85→  if (variantCountsError) {
    86→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    87→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    88→      cause: variantCountsError,
    89→    });
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  if (variantCountsData) {
    93→    for (const item of variantCountsData as Array<{ generation_id: string; viewed_at: string | null }>) {
    94→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    95→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    96→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    97→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    98→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    99→      }
   100→    }
   101→  }
   102→
   103→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   104→}
   105→
   106→/**
   107→ * Fail-open variant of calculateDerivedCounts for non-critical UI surfaces.
   108→ * Keeps badge rendering resilient when counts query intermittently fails.
   109→ */
   110→export async function calculateDerivedCountsSafe(
   111→  generationIds: string[]
   112→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
   113→  try {
   114→    return await calculateDerivedCounts(generationIds);
   115→  } catch (error) {
   116→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'generationTransformers.calculateDerivedCountsSafe', showToast: false });
   117→    return {
   118→      ...createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(),
   119→      degraded: true,
   120→      errorCode: 'query_failed',
   121→    };
   122→  }
   123→}

   200→/**
   201→ * Extract prompt from various nested param structures
   202→ */
   203→function extractPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string {
   204→  if (!params) return 'No prompt';
   205→
   206→  const originalParams = params.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   207→  const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   208→  const metadataBlock = params.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   209→
   210→  return (
   211→    (orchestratorDetails?.prompt as string) ||
   212→    (params.prompt as string) ||
   213→    (metadataBlock?.prompt as string) ||
   214→    'No prompt'
   215→  );
   216→}
   217→
   218→/**
   219→ * Extract thumbnail URL with fallback logic
   220→ * Handles special case for travel-between-images videos where thumbnail might be in params
   221→ */
   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {
   223→  // Start with database thumbnail_url field
   224→  let thumbnailUrl = item.thumbnail_url;
   225→  const toolType = item.params?.tool_type;
   226→  
   227→  // If no thumbnail in database, check params for travel-between-images videos
   228→  if (!thumbnailUrl && isToolId(toolType) && toolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES) {
   229→    const originalParams = item.params?.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   230→    const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   231→    const fullPayload = item.params?.full_orchestrator_payload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   232→    const originalFullPayload = originalParams?.full_orchestrator_payload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   233→
   234→    thumbnailUrl =
   235→      (item.params?.thumbnailUrl as string) ||
   236→      (orchestratorDetails?.thumbnail_url as string) ||
   237→      (fullPayload?.thumbnail_url as string) ||
   238→      (originalFullPayload?.thumbnail_url as string);
   239→  }
   240→  
   241→  // Final fallback to main URL
   242→  return thumbnailUrl || mainUrl;
   243→}
   244→
   245→/**
   246→ * Normalize timeline_frame to position (divide by 50)
   247→ */
   248→function normalizePosition(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
   249→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) return null;
   250→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);
   251→}
   252→
   253→/**
   254→ * Transform a raw generation record from database to UI format
   255→ * 
   256→ * This is the MAIN transformation function used by most hooks/components
   257→ * 
   258→ * @param item - Raw generation from database query
   259→ * @param options - Optional customization (shot context, metadata, etc.)
   260→ * @returns Transformed generation ready for UI display
   261→ */
   262→export function transformGeneration(
   263→  item: RawGeneration,
   264→  options: TransformOptions = {}
   265→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   266→  const mainUrl = item.location;
   267→  const thumbnailUrl = extractThumbnailUrl(item, mainUrl);
   268→  const taskIdParse = parseGenerationTaskId(item.tasks);
   269→  const taskId = taskIdParse.taskId;
   270→  const prompt = extractPrompt(item.params);
   271→  
   272→  // Extract content_type from params for proper download file extensions
   273→  // Stored as 'image' or 'video', convert to MIME type
   274→  const storedContentType = item.params?.content_type;
   275→  const isVideo = item.type?.includes('video') || storedContentType === 'video' || false;
   276→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   277→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   278→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   279→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   280→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   281→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   282→    contentType = 'image/png';
   283→  }
   284→  
   285→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison
   286→  // Supabase URLs have rotating tokens but the file path is stable
   287→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   288→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);
   289→
   290→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   291→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   292→    id: item.id,
   293→    url: mainUrl,
   294→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   295→    urlIdentity,
   296→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   297→    prompt,
   298→    metadata: {
   299→      ...(item.params || {}),
   300→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   301→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   302→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   303→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   304→    },
   305→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   306→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   307→    isVideo,
   308→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   309→    starred: item.starred || false,
   310→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   311→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   312→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    name: item.name || (item.params?.name as string | undefined) || undefined,
   314→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   315→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   316→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   317→    // Parent/child relationship fields
   318→    is_child: item.is_child ?? undefined,
   319→    parent_generation_id: item.parent_generation_id ?? undefined,
   320→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   321→  };
   322→
   323→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.
   324→  const shotGenerations = expandShotData(item.shot_data as Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined);
   325→  
   326→  // If shot context is provided via options, use it
   327→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   328→    return {
   329→      ...baseItem,
   330→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   331→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   332→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   333→    };
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   337→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   338→    // Single shot optimization
   339→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   340→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   341→      return {
   342→        ...baseItem,
   343→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   344→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   345→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   346→      };
   347→    }
   348→    
   349→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   350→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   351→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   352→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   353→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   354→    }));
   355→    
   356→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   357→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   358→    if (options.shotId) {
   359→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   360→      if (matchingShot) {
   361→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   362→      }
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    return {
   366→      ...baseItem,
   367→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   368→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   369→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   370→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   371→    };
   372→  }
   373→  
   374→  return baseItem;
   375→}
   376→
   377→/**
   378→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   379→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   380→ */
   381→export function transformForTimeline(
   382→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   383→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   384→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   385→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   386→  
   387→  if (!genData) {
   388→    return {
   389→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   390→      id: shotGen.id,
   391→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   392→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   393→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   394→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   395→    };
   396→  }
   397→  
   398→  return {
   399→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   400→    id: shotGen.id,
   401→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   402→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   403→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   404→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   405→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   406→    location: genData.location,
   407→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   408→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   409→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   410→    metadata: (shotGen.metadata as GenerationMetadata | undefined) ?? undefined,
   411→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   412→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   413→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   414→  };
   415→}
   416→
   417→/**
   418→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   419→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   420→ */
   421→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   422→  if (!url) return false;
   423→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   424→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   425→}
   426→
   427→/**
   428→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   429→ *
   430→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   431→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   432→ *
   433→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   434→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   435→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   436→ */
   437→export function transformVariant(
   438→  variant: RawVariant,
   439→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   440→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   441→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   442→  const variantParams = (variant.params ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   443→  const storedContentType = variantParams.content_type as string | undefined;
   444→
   445→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   446→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   447→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   448→  } else {
   449→    contentType = 'image/png';
   450→  }
   451→
   452→  return {
   453→    id: variant.id,
   454→    url: variant.location,
   455→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   456→    isVideo,
   457→    contentType,
   458→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   459→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   460→    metadata: {
   461→      prompt: variantParams.prompt as string | undefined,
   462→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   463→      name: variant.name,
   464→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   465→      tool_type: (variantParams.tool_type as string) || options?.toolType,
   466→      created_from: variantParams.created_from as string | undefined,
   467→      source_task_id: variantParams.source_task_id as string | undefined,
   468→      content_type: storedContentType,
   469→    },
   470→    shot_id: undefined,
   471→    position: undefined,
   472→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   473→  };
   474→}
   475→

    27→export function useRelativeTimestamp({
    28→  date,

    34→
    35→  return useLiveRelativeTimestamp({
    36→    dateInput: date,
    37→    disabled,
    38→    formatter: (parsedDate) => formatter(parsedDate, abbreviate),
    39→  });
    40→}
    41→

    84→async function rawUpdateToolSettings(write: QueuedWrite): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {

   104→      if (errorMessage.includes('ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES') ||

   106→          fetchError.code === 'ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES') {
   107→        throw new ToolSettingsError(

   126→    // This is much faster than update() because it happens in a single DB operation
   127→    throwIfAborted(signal);

   144→    }

   146→    // CRITICAL: Return the full merged settings, not just the patch

   149→    return updatedToolSettings;

   207→    patch: patch as Record<string, unknown>,
   208→    ...(signal ? { signal } : {}),
   209→  }, mode) as Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
   210→}
   211→
   212→// ============================================================================
   213→// Cache format helpers
   214→// ============================================================================
   215→
   216→/**
   217→ * Helper to check if a cache value has the wrapper format.
   218→ * fetchToolSettingsSupabase always returns { settings, hasShotSettings },
   219→ * but legacy or manually-set cache entries may use flat format.
   220→ */
   221→function isSettingsWrapper(data: unknown): data is SettingsFetchResult {
   222→  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return false;
   223→  return 'settings' in data && 'hasShotSettings' in data;
   224→}
   225→
   226→/**
   227→ * Helper to extract settings from cache data (handles wrapper format)
   228→ * Cache stores data as { settings: T, hasShotSettings: boolean }
   229→ */
   230→export function extractSettingsFromCache<T>(cacheData: unknown): T | undefined {
   231→  if (!cacheData) return undefined;
   232→  return isSettingsWrapper(cacheData) ? (cacheData.settings as T) : (cacheData as T);
   233→}
   234→
   235→/**
   236→ * Helper to update settings cache with proper wrapper format
   237→ * Use this in setQueryData callbacks for optimistic updates
   238→ *
   239→ * @param prev - The previous cache value (may be wrapper or flat format)
   240→ * @param updater - Either an object of updates, or a function that receives prevSettings and returns updates
   241→ */
   242→export function updateSettingsCache<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
   243→  prev: unknown,
   244→  updater: Partial<T> | ((prevSettings: T) => Partial<T>)
   245→): SettingsFetchResult<T> {
   246→  const wrapper = isSettingsWrapper(prev);
   247→  const prevSettings = (wrapper ? ((prev as SettingsFetchResult).settings ?? {}) : (prev ?? {})) as T;
   248→  const updates = typeof updater === 'function' ? updater(prevSettings) : updater;
   249→  return {
   250→    settings: { ...prevSettings, ...updates } as T,
   251→    hasShotSettings: wrapper ? ((prev as SettingsFetchResult).hasShotSettings ?? false) : false
   252→  };
   253→}
   254→
   255→// ============================================================================
   256→// Query retry helper
   257→// ============================================================================
   258→
   259→/** Determines whether a failed settings query should be retried. */
   260→function shouldRetrySettingsQuery(failureCount: number, error: Error): boolean {
   261→  const classified = classifyToolSettingsError(error);
   262→  if (
   263→    classified.code === 'auth_required'
   264→    || classified.code === 'cancelled'
   265→    || classified.code === 'network'
   266→  ) {
   267→    return false;
   268→  }
   269→  return failureCount < 3;
   270→}
   271→
   272→// ============================================================================
   273→// Mutation success/error helpers
   274→// ============================================================================
   275→
   276→/** Merge mutation result into query cache and refetch related caches. */
   277→function handleMutationSuccess(
   278→  fullMergedSettings: Record<string, unknown> | null,
   279→  toolId: string,
   280→  projectId: string | undefined,
   281→  shotId: string | undefined,
   282→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
   283→) {
   284→  if (fullMergedSettings === null) return;
   285→
   286→  queryClient.setQueryData(
   287→    queryKeys.settings.tool(toolId, projectId, shotId),
   288→    (oldData: unknown) => {
   289→      const oldWrapper = isSettingsWrapper(oldData);
   290→      const oldSettings = oldWrapper
   291→        ? (((oldData as SettingsFetchResult).settings ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>)
   292→        : ((oldData ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>);
   293→      const mergedSettings = deepMerge({}, oldSettings, fullMergedSettings);
   294→
   295→      return {
   296→        settings: mergedSettings,
   297→        hasShotSettings: oldWrapper ? ((oldData as SettingsFetchResult).hasShotSettings ?? false) : false
   298→      };
   299→    }
   300→  );
   301→
   302→  if (shotId) {
   303→    queryClient.refetchQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });
   304→  }
   305→}
   306→
   307→/** Log/toast mutation errors and invalidate cache for non-network failures. */
   308→function handleMutationError(
   309→  error: Error,
   310→  toolId: string,
   311→  projectId: string | undefined,
   312→  shotId: string | undefined,
   313→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
   314→) {
   315→  const classified = classifyToolSettingsError(error);
   316→
   317→  if (classified.code === 'cancelled') {
   318→    return;
   319→  }
   320→
   321→  if (classified.code === 'network') return;
   322→
   323→  normalizeAndPresentError(classified, { context: 'useToolSettings.update', toastTitle: `Failed to save ${toolId} settings` });
   324→
   325→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   326→    [REDACTED](toolId, projectId, shotId)
   327→  });
   328→}
   329→
   330→// Type overloads
   331→export function useToolSettings<T>(toolId: string, context?: { projectId?: string; shotId?: string; enabled?: boolean }): {
   332→  settings: T | undefined;
   333→  isLoading: boolean;
   334→  error: Error | null;
   335→  update: (scope: SettingsScope, settings: Partial<T>) => Promise<void>;
   336→  isUpdating: boolean;
   337→  /** Whether the shot had settings stored in DB (vs just defaults/project settings) */
   338→  hasShotSettings: boolean;
   339→};
   340→
   341→/**
   342→ * Low-level hook for reading and writing tool settings across all scopes.
   343→ *
   344→ * Performs cascade resolution (defaults -> user -> project -> shot) and returns
   345→ * a merged settings object. Writes go through the global settings write queue.
   346→ *
   347→ * Most features should use `useAutoSaveSettings` instead, which adds auto-save,
   348→ * dirty tracking, and entity-change handling on top of this hook.
   349→ *
   350→ * Use this directly only when you need manual save control or complex write patterns.
   351→ *
   352→ * @see docs/structure_detail/settings_system.md for the full settings hook decision tree
   353→ */
   354→export function useToolSettings<T>(
   355→  toolId: string,
   356→  context?: { projectId?: string; shotId?: string; enabled?: boolean }
   357→) {
   358→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   359→
   360→  // Determine parameter shapes
   361→  const projectIdFromRuntime = getProjectSelectionFallbackId() ?? undefined;
   362→  const projectId: string | undefined = context?.projectId ?? projectIdFromRuntime ?? undefined;
   363→  const shotId: string | undefined = context?.shotId;
   364→  const fetchEnabled: boolean = context?.enabled ?? true;
   365→
   366→  // Refs to access current values in stable callbacks without recreating them
   367→  const projectIdRef = useRef(projectId);
   368→  projectIdRef.current = projectId;
   369→  const shotIdRef = useRef(shotId);
   370→  shotIdRef.current = shotId;
   371→
   372→  // Fetch merged settings using Supabase with mobile optimizations
   373→  const { data: queryResult, isLoading, error } = useQuery({
   374→    [REDACTED](toolId, projectId, shotId),
   375→    queryFn: async ({ signal }): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> => {
   376→      return fetchToolSettingsSupabaseOrThrow(toolId, { projectId, shotId }, signal);
   377→    },
   378→    enabled: !!toolId && fetchEnabled,
   379→    ...QUERY_PRESETS.static,
   380→    staleTime: 10 * 60 * 1000,
   381→    retry: shouldRetrySettingsQuery,
   382→    retryDelay: STANDARD_RETRY_DELAY,
   383→    networkMode: 'online',
   384→  });
   385→
   386→  // Extract settings and hasShotSettings from the query result
   387→  const wrapper = isSettingsWrapper(queryResult);
   388→  const settings = wrapper ? (queryResult as SettingsFetchResult).settings : queryResult;
   389→  const hasShotSettings = wrapper ? ((queryResult as SettingsFetchResult).hasShotSettings ?? false) : false;
   390→
   391→  // Log errors for debugging (except expected cancellations)
   392→  if (error && classifyToolSettingsError(error).code !== 'cancelled') {
   393→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useToolSettings', showToast: false });
   394→  }
   395→
   396→  // Update settings mutation
   397→  const updateMutation = useMutation({
   398→    mutationFn: async ({ scope, settings: newSettings, entityId }: {
   399→      scope: SettingsScope;
   400→      settings: Partial<T>;
   401→      entityId?: string;
   402→    }) => {
   403→      let idForScope: string | undefined = entityId;
   404→
   405→      if (!idForScope) {
   406→        if (scope === 'user') {
   407→          const { data: { user } } = await resolveAndCacheUserId();
   408→          idForScope = user?.id;
   409→          if (!idForScope) {
   410→            throw new ToolSettingsError(
   411→              'auth_required',
   412→              'Authentication required for user settings update',
   413→            );
   414→          }
   415→        } else if (scope === 'project') {
   416→          idForScope = projectId;
   417→        } else if (scope === 'shot') {
   418→          idForScope = shotId;
   419→        }
   420→      }
   421→
   422→      if (!idForScope) {
   423→        throw new ToolSettingsError(
   424→          'invalid_scope_identifier',
   425→          `Missing identifier for ${scope} tool settings update`,
   426→        );
   427→      }
   428→
   429→      const fullMergedSettings = await updateToolSettingsSupabase({
   430→          scope,
   431→          id: idForScope,
   432→          toolId,
   433→          patch: newSettings,
   434→      });
   435→
   436→      return fullMergedSettings;
   437→    },
   438→    onSuccess: (fullMergedSettings) => {
   439→      handleMutationSuccess(fullMergedSettings, toolId, projectId, shotId, queryClient);
   440→    },
   441→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   442→      handleMutationError(error, toolId, projectId, shotId, queryClient);
   443→    },
   444→  });
   445→
   446→  // Get stable reference to mutateAsync - useMutation returns a new object each render
   447→  // but mutateAsync itself is stable
   448→  const mutateAsyncRef = useRef(updateMutation.mutateAsync);
   449→  mutateAsyncRef.current = updateMutation.mutateAsync;
   450→
   451→  // CRITICAL: Wrap in useCallback with stable deps to prevent cascading re-renders.
   452→  // Use refs to access current projectId/shotId without recreating this function.
   453→  // The entityId is snapshotted at call time via refs for correctness.
   454→  const update = useCallback(async (scope: SettingsScope, settings: Partial<T>): Promise<void> => {
   455→    // Snapshot the target entity id NOW to prevent cross-project/shot overwrites
   456→    // Use refs to get current values without causing callback recreation
   457→    const entityId = scope === 'project' ? projectIdRef.current : (scope === 'shot' ? shotIdRef.current : undefined);
   458→
   459→    // NOTE: No debounce here - callers (like useShotSettings) are responsible for debouncing.
   460→    // Using mutateAsync so callers can await the actual DB write completion.
   461→    // Use ref to access stable mutateAsync without recreating this callback.
   462→    await mutateAsyncRef.current({ scope, settings, entityId });
   463→  }, []); // Empty deps - all values accessed via refs for stability
   464→
   465→  return useMemo(() => ({
   466→    settings: settings as T | undefined,
   467→    isLoading,
   468→    error: error as Error | null,
   469→    update,
   470→    isUpdating: updateMutation.isPending,
   471→    hasShotSettings,
   472→  }), [settings, isLoading, error, update, updateMutation.isPending, hasShotSettings]);
   473→}
   474→

    93→function resolveSiblingLimits(params: StripTapPlacementParams) {

   101→    if (sibling.start >= params.effectiveOutputEnd && sibling.start < rightLimit) {
   102→      rightLimit = sibling.start;
   103→    }
   104→  }
   105→
   106→  return { leftLimit, rightLimit };

   112→  const normalizedX = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (params.touchX - timelineLeft) / fullTimelineWidth));
